title: C4OS Grill Question 049 - App Tool Taxonomy And Pi Proof

questions.label: Which app-tool taxonomy should be frozen before plugin details?
questions.help: Recommended: freeze categories and representative tool IDs, not every final tool. This gives policy/proof structure without pretending implementation details are complete.
options: Freeze categories and representative tool IDs only
Freeze every final app tool ID before plugin specs continue
Let each plugin define its own taxonomy independently

questions.label: Which app-tool categories must be represented first?
questions.help: Recommended: shell, runtime, files, git/worktree, terminal, browser, artifact/preview, plugin, skill, config, and marketplace.
options: Shell, runtime, files, git/worktree, terminal, browser, artifact/preview, plugin, skill, config, marketplace
Only files, terminal, browser, and runtime

questions.label: Which Pi capabilities are proof-critical?
questions.help: Recommended: all listed capabilities are proof-critical because the proof needs to reveal app-layer adjustments before implementation.
options: Prompt execution, streaming, tool-call interception, approval denial, and resume
Tool-call interception and approval denial only

questions.label: Where should `/` prompt commands route?
questions.help: Recommended: route through runtime/tool gateway command handling, with C4OS and plugins contributing command definitions instead of a separate ad hoc palette path.
options: Runtime/tool gateway command handling with C4OS and plugin command definitions

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify specific tool IDs, naming conventions, whether marketplace tools are app tools, or how `/` commands should display in prompt suggestions.
